settings.description: What you can do with the files you buy here, without the legal language.

settings.label: You can
settings.heading: Use it in your own and client work
settings.text: Websites, social posts, printed pieces, videos and products you sell, as many times as you like.

settings.label: You cannot
settings.heading: Pass the files on
settings.text: Reselling, sharing or giving away the files, even changed, is not allowed. Send people here instead.

settings.label: Teams
settings.heading: One licence per person
settings.text: Buying for a team? Buy one per person who uses the files, or write to us for a team price.
Edit this page to match how your files may be used.

settings.question: What counts as client work?
settings.answer: Anything you make for someone else, paid or not: a logo, a website, a set of photos, a printed menu. The finished work belongs to them; the files stay yours.

settings.question: Can I sell things I made with the files?
settings.answer: Yes. You can sell prints, products, videos or designs made with the files, as long as the files themselves cannot be pulled back out and reused.

settings.question: Can I post the files online?
settings.answer: Not the files themselves. Post the work you made with them as much as you like.

settings.question: Does the licence expire?
settings.answer: No. Once you have paid, the licence is yours for good, including future updates of the same file.

settings.question: What about fonts?
settings.answer: Fonts come with a desktop licence for one person. Using a font on a website or in an app needs the web licence, which is sold on the font's page.
